mensagens.input: Sometimes, it is easier to estimate fractions when they are in mixed number form. When you are estimating 13/8 on the line, you will have to count 13 parts, but try estimating its mixed number form, 1 and 5/8; you only have to estimate 5 parts after "1"! Show where 1 and 5/8 lies on the number line.
What is the fraction in the problem?
